exposure: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection markers (CMV DNA, IgG, IgG avidity)
cohort: The study included 141 pregnant women aged 19-45 years, each with fetal anomalies, whose serum and amniotic fluid samples were assessed.
finding: CMV DNA was detected in 17 (12.05%) amniotic fluid samples, with 82% of these exhibiting central nervous system abnormalities, leading to the conclusion that serological tests alone are insufficient for diagnosing congenital CMV infection during pregnancy.
